title: factual_accuracy gate scored 0.0 despite correct code
evidence: scores.json factual_accuracy=0.0; _factual.json note 'no tool returned a 2019 Serie A table naming Flamengo (tried 4 candidate tools)'. But direct MCP calls verified correct: standings(Serie A,2019) => '1. Flamengo — 90 pts (28W,6D,4L)' and ask('Who won the 2019 Brasileirao?') => 'Flamengo won ... 90 points'. loader_test.go:29 also asserts Standings('Brasileirao',2019)[0]=Flamengo/90 and tests pass (test_coverage=0.786).

title: strings.Title is deprecated (Go 1.18+)
evidence: natural.go:113 uses strings.Title(position); models compile clean under go 1.26 but the API is deprecated in favor of golang.org/x/text/cases.
suggestion: Cosmetic; no functional impact for single-word ASCII position labels.

title: Extended-dataset competition names pass through titleWords un-canonicalized
evidence: loader.go:206 sets competition = titleWords(tournament) for BR-Football-Dataset.csv; only canonicalCompetition() folds known names, so novel tournament strings remain as-is in the union view.
suggestion: Analytical views already prefer authoritative single-source CSVs via sourcePriority, so double-counting is avoided; extended-source labels only affect free-form search results.
